name: Upleash Veterinary Hospital
source: Official branch service/team/contact review; A03 owner-approved reconciliation, 2026-10-11
availability_note: Local chemotherapy and tumor/mass-removal surgery are offered. Advanced procedures may involve a visiting board-certified surgeon; confirm the assigned clinician and schedule. An optional oncology consultation does not establish an on-site medical oncologist.
clinician_review: Current team: Joe Spoo, DVM, DACVSMR (canine); Krista Hardy, DVM, DABVP (canine/feline); Evan Ward, DVM, DMV, CCRT. These are not DACVIM Oncology credentials. The visiting surgeon is not named on the reviewed page.

owner_review.decision: Retain local chemotherapy; tumor surgery remains unconfirmed. No Oncology board credential inferred from VSMR/ABVP.

name: All Creatures Veterinary Hospital
source: Official branch advanced surgical services and contact pages: visiting specialist performs skin, abdominal and liver mass removal locally.
care_delivery: physical branch; monthly visiting surgical specialist
availability_note: Monthly visits by Kari Swanson for specialty surgery, including skin, abdominal and liver mass removal. Call the hospital for an initial consultation; the hospital coordinates records and surgery with the visiting surgeon.
clinician_review: Kari Swanson is listed by the hospital as a Diplomate of the American College of Veterinary Surgeons and visiting surgeon. Her own service describes her as a board-certified small animal veterinary surgeon. This is a surgery credential; oncology board certification is not claimed. The branch roster lists Dean Falcon, Grace Evans and Wendy Blickensderfer; they are not represented as oncologists.
coordinate_source: Exact address verified on official branch contact page; building coordinates and a validated ZIP centroid were not established.
